The '''Gorinth Agricultural Sector''' was a farming region located on the southern edge of the [[Markaran Plains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. The [[Stillwater Farms]] were located there, as was the toxic [[Glowwater Swamp]].
